fields.note: The smeared lattice buckle half-wave pi*sqrt(1.06*rg*R) is 0.57 of the member at 022b's s 6.15 m (40 nodes) and 0.64 at s 5.5 m, against 1.48 at 011b's s 2.04 m and 4.56 at the Mylar s 0.55 m frame.
